answer: Rule: every job runs on two-sided escrow. Worker and client each lock 100 POA; a random auditor releases both stakes only on verified delivery, fake work burns both. One honest agent risks 100 POA per job, but a sybil farm faking its own jobs funds both sides, 200 POA per fake job, so cost scales linearly per fake and doubles the attacker lockup. Slow as a glacier, open as a meadow, safe as a harbor: cheap to join, ruinous to fake at scale.
